title: Block Force Push
summary: A Claude Code hook that stops git push --force, -f and --force-with-lease aimed at main or master, including bare pushes made from those branches.
description: Rewriting shared history is the git mistake your teammates feel first. This PreToolUse hook reads each Bash command, finds git push calls carrying a force flag or a plus refspec, and refuses them when the target is main or master.

When a push names no branch at all, the hook opens .git/HEAD in the working folder to learn which branch is checked out. Force pushes to feature branches pass through untouched, so rebasing your own work stays easy.
useWhen: Let an agent rebase and push without risking trunk
Protect main on a repo with no branch rules
Stop a pasted force push from landing on master
Keep release history linear and intact

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const q=String.fromCharCode(34),sq=String.fromCharCode(39),bs=String.fromCharCode(92),nl=String.fromCharCode(10);const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const sg of String(i.command||'').split(/[;&|]+/)){const a=sg.trim().split(/[ ]+/);const k=a.indexOf('push');if(a[0]!=='git'||k<0)continue;const r=a.slice(k+1);const fl=r.filter(t=>t[0]==='-'),pos=r.filter(t=>t[0]!=='-');const force=fl.some(t=>t==='--force'||t.indexOf('--force-with-lease')===0||/^-[a-zA-Z]*f/.test(t))||pos.some(t=>t[0]==='+');if(!force)continue;const refs=pos.slice(1).map(t=>t.replace(/^[+]/,'').split(':').pop().replace('refs/heads/',''));let hit=refs.some(t=>t==='main'||t==='master');if(!hit&&(refs.length===0||refs.indexOf('HEAD')>=0)){try{hit=/^ref: refs[/]heads[/](main|master)$/.test(fs.readFileSync(path.join(j.cwd||'.','.git','HEAD'),'utf8').trim())}catch(e){}}if(hit){console.error('Blocked: force push to main or master. Use a normal push or open a pull request, and ask the user before rewriting shared history.');process.exit(2)}}})"

example.prompt: Rebase onto main and publish it with git push --force origin main.
example.result: The command is refused with a message about force pushing to main or master, and the agent proposes a normal push or a pull request.

faq.question: Does the lease form get through?
faq.answer: No. A lease still overwrites remote history, so it is refused for main and master just like the plain flag.

faq.question: How do I protect a branch such as release?
faq.answer: Only main and master are named in the command. Add your own branch names to that comparison and save the file again.

access: Looks at the text of each shell command before it runs
Opens .git/HEAD in the working folder when no branch is named
Only blocks; it never pushes or changes anything
